home.title: Human Resources
home.description: Employment records with as-of history, headcount, and change-request tracking.

vitals.openPositionsSub: {count, plural, one {# establishment recruiting} other {# establishments recruiting}}
vitals.unfundedFteSub: Filled with no funding behind it

groups.title: Headcount by employer and department
groups.empty: No employments are in service as of {date}.

vacancy.title: Vacancy by department
vacancy.empty: No positions are established as of {date}.

pending.label: Pending requests
pending.title: Pending change requests
pending.empty: No change requests are awaiting decision.

upcoming.title: Starting and ending soon
upcoming.hint: Effective starts and ends in the next 30 days. Probation periods are not modeled on the employment record, so probation ends never list here.
upcoming.startsEmpty: Nobody starts in the next 30 days.
upcoming.endsEmpty: Nobody ends in the next 30 days.

recent.title: Recent employment changes
recent.empty: No employment changes have been recorded yet.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.healthy: Every active employee party has an employment record.
readiness.unmigrated: {count} active employee parties have no employment record — they are not yet migrated to employment records and headcount excludes them.

queue.title: Change requests
queue.description: Every employment change proposal in one queue — drafts, submissions, and decisions — resolved through the change-request service.
queue.truncatedNote: Showing the first {limit} requests — segment counts cover only those.
queue.unknownSegment: Unknown segment {value} — filter by draft, submitted, approved, rejected, or withdrawn, or clear the filter.
queue.emptyDescription: This view is empty — nothing has been proposed in this segment yet.
queue.proposeTitle: Propose a change for an employment
queue.proposeFailed: The employment list could not be loaded.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Headcount as of today per department, with the employer subsidiary breakdown — resolved through the headcount service.
departments.listNote: The employees list has no department filter, so drill-through opens the full list.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Workforce reports: the headcount statement preset and the employment entities, opened in the report builder.
reports.presetHint: The preset opens the org's saved plan — or the builder catalog while the seed has never materialized.
reports.entitiesHint: Start a new workforce report from one of the employment entities.

noRecord.title: No employment record
noRecord.description: This person has no employment record yet. Employment records are created by the HRM authoring flow.

multiple.title: More than one employment record
multiple.description: {count} employment records name this person. The record cannot be chosen automatically — resolve the duplicates before reading as-of state.

changeRequests.title: Change requests
changeRequests.authoringDescription: The proposal is validated against the governed payload contract. Saving a draft stores only the payload; submitting stamps the reason and opens the approval run.
changeRequests.effectiveToHint: Leave blank for an open-ended window.
changeRequests.assignmentKeyRequired: Name the assignment slot this change edits.
changeRequests.locationHint: Active locations of this organization. Inactive or out-of-scope locations never list.
changeRequests.managerHint: People holding an employment in this organization. The reporting line closes onto the chosen employment — removal is not modeled.
changeRequests.fteHint: Decimal string, up to 4 fraction digits. Sent exactly as typed.
changeRequests.reasonRequired: Record why the change is proposed.
changeRequests.reasonSubmitNote: The reason is required to submit or withdraw. It is stamped on the approval run, not stored on the draft.
changeRequests.submitDescription: Submitting opens the governed approval run. The reason is stamped on the run.
changeRequests.withdrawDescription: Withdrawing a pending request also cancels its approval run. The reason is recorded as audit evidence.
changeRequests.requestFailed: The change request could not be saved.
changeRequests.positionHint: The funded establishment this assignment holds. The assignment keeps its own title, department, and location.
changeRequests.positionRequired: Pick a position or mark the assignment as unassigned.
changeRequests.unassignHint: Posts an explicit null link: the slot keeps its content but holds no establishment.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: The funded establishment behind the headcount plan: planned, funded, and filled FTE per position with its versions, funding by period, and current holder.

drawer.title: Position {code}
drawer.missing: This position is no longer visible.

processes.title: Process checklists
processes.description: Onboarding, offboarding, and transfer checklists with owners, due dates, and evidence.

leave.title: Leave
leave.description: Requests, approvals, and the absence record — with balances in time and, where a bank exists, in value.
leave.calendarEmpty: No absences in this window. Pick a department to resolve the calendar.
leave.detailFailed: The request could not be loaded.
leave.fileFailed: The request could not be filed.
leave.noPolicyBalance: No policy covers this employment on these dates.

myLeave.title: My leave
myLeave.description: Your requests and balances — nothing else lists here.
myLeave.emptyDescription: File your first request to see it here.
